answers.core: I don't think the necessary information is exposed to add-on creators. It also feels like a missing link in what should(?) be a bidirectional conversion.
answers.workaround: No. As far as I'm aware, doing so would require pre-caching a map of all possible conversions via `DisplayServer.keyboard_get_keycode_from_physical()` and then reversing it.
